import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Point {
        int r, c, dis;
        Point(int r, int c, int dis) {
            this.r = r;
            this.c = c;
            this.dis = dis;
        }
    }

    static int[] dr = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static int[] dc = {0, -1, 0, 1};
    static Queue<Point> bfsQueue = new LinkedList<>();
    static char[] input = new char[15];
    static int totalNodes = 0, sinkNode = 0, m, limit, totalPath = 0;
    static int[] pred = new int[202];
    static int[] dist = new int[202];
    static int[] height = new int[202];
    static int[] gap = new int[203];
    static int[][] cap = new int[202][202];
    static int[][] flow = new int[202][202];
    static int[] path = new int[202];
    static boolean[][] gridVis = new boolean[12][12];
    static boolean[][] origGrid = new boolean[12][12];
    static boolean pathFound = false;
    static int[][] a = new int[12][12];
    static int[][] b = new int[12][12];

    static void augmentPath(int u, int bottleneck) {
        if (u == sinkNode) {
            pred[0] = bottleneck;
            pathFound = true;
            return;
        }
        int minHeight = sinkNode + 2;
        for (int v = 0; v <= sinkNode + 1; ++v) {
            if (flow[u][v] < cap[u][v]) {
                minHeight = Math.min(minHeight, height[v]);
                if (height[u] == height[v] + 1) {
                    path[++totalPath] = v;
                    augmentPath(v, Math.min(bottleneck, cap[u][v] - flow[u][v]));
                    if (!gridVis[0][0] || pathFound) return;
                    path[totalPath--] = 0;
                }
            }
            if (flow[v][u] > 0) {
                minHeight = Math.min(minHeight, height[v]);
                if (height[u] == height[v] + 1) {
                    path[++totalPath] = -v;
                    augmentPath(v, Math.min(bottleneck, flow[v][u]));
                    if (!gridVis[0][0] || pathFound) return;
                    path[totalPath--] = 0;
                }
            }
        }
        if (minHeight + 1 != height[u]) {
            --gap[height[u]];
            if (gap[height[u]] == 0) gridVis[0][0] = false;
            height[u] = minHeight + 1;
            ++gap[height[u]];
        }
    }

    static boolean findPath() {
        pathFound = false;
        pred[0] = sinkNode;
        totalPath = 0;
        path[0] = 0;
        augmentPath(0, sinkNode);
        return pathFound;
    }

    static void pushFlow() {
        for (int i = 1; i <= totalPath; ++i) {
            if (path[i] > 0) {
                flow[Math.abs(path[i - 1])][path[i]] += pred[0];
            } else {
                flow[-path[i]][Math.abs(path[i - 1])] -= pred[0];
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        m = scanner.nextInt();
        limit = scanner.nextInt();
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
            String line = scanner.next();
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; ++j) {
                input[j] = line.charAt(j - 1);
                if (input[j] == 'Z') {
                    Point start = new Point(i, j, 0);
                    bfsQueue.add(start);
                } else if (input[j] != 'Y') {
                    gridVis[i][j] = true;
                    origGrid[i][j] = true;
                    dist[i][j] = limit;
                    int val = input[j] - '0';
                    if (val > 0) {
                        a[i][j] = ++totalNodes;
                        cap[0][totalNodes] = val;
                        sinkNode += val;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        System.arraycopy(gridVis, 0, origGrid, 0, gridVis.length);
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
            String line = scanner.next();
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; ++j) {
                input[j] = line.charAt(j - 1);
                if (input[j] == 'Z' || input[j] == 'Y') continue;
                int val = input[j] - '0';
                if (val > 0) {
                    b[i][j] = ++totalNodes;
                    cap[totalNodes][m * m + 1] = val;
                }
            }
        }
        
        if (totalNodes != m * m) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i)
                for (int j = 1; j <= m; ++j)
                    if (b[i][j] > 0) {
                        int idx = b[i][j];
                        cap[idx][totalNodes + 1] = cap[idx][m * m + 1];
                        cap[idx][m * m + 1] = 0;
                    }
        }
        
        while (!bfsQueue.isEmpty()) {
            Point cur = bfsQueue.poll();
            int r = cur.r, c = cur.c;
            dist[r][c] = cur.dis;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int nr = r + dr[k], nc = c + dc[k];
                if (nr >= 0 && nr < 12 && nc >= 0 && nc < 12 && gridVis[nr][nc]) {
                    Point next = new Point(nr, nc, cur.dis + 1);
                    bfsQueue.add(next);
                    gridVis[nr][nc] = false;
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; ++j) {
                if (a[i][j] == 0) continue;
                System.arraycopy(origGrid, 0, gridVis, 0, gridVis.length);
                gridVis[i][j] = false;
                Point start = new Point(i, j, 0);
                bfsQueue.add(start);
                while (!bfsQueue.isEmpty()) {
                    Point cur = bfsQueue.poll();
                    int r = cur.r, c = cur.c;
                    if (b[r][c] > 0 && cur.dis <= dist[r][c]) {
                        cap[a[i][j]][b[r][c]] = sinkNode;
                    }
                    if (cur.dis + 1 > limit || cur.dis >= dist[r][c]) continue;
                    for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                        int nr = r + dr[k], nc = c + dc[k];
                        if (nr >= 0 && nr < 12 && nc >= 0 && nc < 12 && gridVis[nr][nc]) {
                            Point next = new Point(nr, nc, cur.dis + 1);
                            bfsQueue.add(next);
                            gridVis[nr][nc] = false;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        gap[0] = totalNodes + 2;
        gridVis[0][0] = true;
        while (gridVis[0][0] && height[0] <= totalNodes + 2) {
            while (findPath()) {
                pushFlow();
            }
        }
        
        int result = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= totalNodes; ++i) {
            result += flow[i][totalNodes + 1];
        }
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
